title: Investigating Bias Representations in Llama 2 Chat via Activation Steering

bias_targets.methodology: Applying contrastive activation addition (activation steering) using steering vectors derived from custom stereotype/anti-stereotype prompt pairs, and evaluating the model's generated text completions for occupation-related templates.
Using contrastive activation addition with steering vectors derived from the StereoSet dataset, and analyzing the steered model's text completions for prompts referencing different racial groups.

Extracting bias steering vectors from contrastive prompt pairs in the StereoSet dataset, applying them via activation steering, and evaluating model completions for prompts mentioning different religious identities.
